title: Identify RPM package state and file providers
goal: Query installed NEVRA, architecture, ownership and package/source/license fields; distinguish RPM from its dependency frontend.
challenge: Find the installed provider of /usr/bin/sh and record its installed name/version/release/architecture, source/license metadata and one listed installed path. Distinguish this provider from ownership of the retained ll-rpm-data-1.0-1.noarch.rpm archive file. Do not install anything; retain factual output and unchanged package state.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/rpm-inventory.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/rpm-inventory.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here || return 19; test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; cfg() { case "$1" in /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave) ;; *) return 19;; esac; here && test "$(realpath -e /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = /etc/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = root:root:755 && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$1")" = root:root:644:1; }; keepcfg() { cfg "$1" && fresh "$w/$2" && cp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1; }; releasecfg() { cfg "$1" && test "${2##*/}" = "$2" && test -f "$w/$2" && test ! -L "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1 && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && sudo rm -- "$1"; }; h=/usr/local/sbin/ll-rpm-fixture; f=/opt/learning-lab/rpm-fixtures; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && fresh "$w/before.json" && sudo "$h" status > before.json && grep -F '"fixtures": {}' before.json && fresh "$w/before-raw.tsv" && timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{EPOCHNUM}\t%{VERSION}\t%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\n' > before-raw.tsv && fresh "$w/before.tsv" && LC_ALL=C sort before-raw.tsv > before.tsv && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this private path and shell definitions. A guard failure stops the exercise; do not continue over existing fixtures. Resume requires recorded path/definitions, not replaying setup.
steps.expected: Fixture-free package baseline retained without masking query failure.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/metadata.txt" && fresh "$w/files.txt" && timeout -k 1s 20s rpm --version && timeout -k 1s 20s dnf --version && rpm -q bash rpm dnf && rpm -qf /usr/bin/sh && rpm -qi bash > metadata.txt && rpm -ql bash > files.txt && head -n 12 metadata.txt && head -n 12 files.txt
steps.explanation: Query actual installed metadata. Complete output stays private; only a short excerpt is displayed.
steps.expected: Native versions, installed NEVRA and bash as /usr/bin/sh provider.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here || return 19; fresh "$w/archive-owner.txt" || return 19; if rpm -qf "$f/ll-rpm-data-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > archive-owner.txt 2>&1; then return 1; else rc=$?; test "$rc" = 1 && grep -F "is not owned by any package" archive-owner.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: A retained archive is not an installed package. Require the actual specific failure, not any nonzero status.
steps.expected: Archive unowned; installed fixtures still absent.

hints: Missing package differs from unowned file; DNF-compatible yum does not demonstrate legacy YUM; Zypper is absent.
Read supported helper operations and the exact plan before APPLY. Unsigned fixture digests do not prove publisher authenticity.
Verify versions, payload/config bytes and actual learner access; package exit status alone is insufficient.
review: I retained the requested actual output, statuses, versions and byte/access evidence, including the incorrect case.
I met the selected mode’s outcomes and can explain the limitations. Completion records self-review, not a score or verified assessment.
I preserved originals and retained candidates, compared unrelated package state and completed only the exact cleanup.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 102.5 102.5 installed metadata/file-provider; DNF awareness. DNF4 awareness, not original YUM, DNF5 or Zypper proficiency. No complete-objective or LPI endorsement claim.
